symptom: A public spa card displays a large unavailable-image panel and business detail transitions feel very slow.
expected_behavior: Only cards with working real media remain visible, and predictable public detail transitions render quickly from platform-owned accepted data.
environment: Public VII version 589 and local release/v587-sitewide-breadcrumbs candidate on 2026-10-23.

steps: Inspect the supplied broken spa card.
Trace PreviewCardGallery exhaustion with a single image.
Trace public vacation and event detail server reads.
Measure browser-like cold and warm document responses.
reproduction.evidence: PreviewCardGallery prints unavailable copy after exhaustion; SpaPackageDeals passes one image; public detail routes await liveSupplierPlaceDetail, whose supplier request timeout is 12 seconds; measured cold business HTML was about 2.0 seconds while memory-cache hits were about 0.1 to 0.17 seconds.

observations.observation: The spa rail has enough offers to withdraw a media-invalid card without inventing a replacement image.
observations.evidence: SpaPackageDeals maps a multi-offer rail and each card owns its media failure state.

observations.observation: The accepted detail snapshot already contains the rooms, gallery and reviews needed by public pages.
observations.evidence: publicCatalogDetail reads the active platform snapshot with a bundled fallback.

observations.observation: NewTabNavigation intentionally marks business-depth routes as target blank.
SmartNavigationWarmup previously rejected every non-self target.

hypotheses.mechanism: A single failed image source leaves the card body visible around a placeholder media panel.
hypotheses.prediction: Removing the whole offer after final image failure eliminates the supplied state without fake imagery.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Force complete media exhaustion and inspect the rail DOM.
hypotheses.result: Supported by source trace; candidate test pending build/browser verification.

hypotheses.mechanism: Public detail rendering is coupled to slow live supplier calls despite an accepted snapshot already existing.
hypotheses.prediction: Rendering from publicCatalogDetail removes upstream latency and failure from the page critical path while preserving accepted details.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Assert page sources contain publicCatalogDetail and no liveSupplierPlaceDetail, then compare production timing after deployment.
hypotheses.result: Supported by source trace and focused contract; production verification pending.

hypotheses.prediction: Warming both router data and document cache on intent reduces predictable detail transition wait without changing tab behavior.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inspect listener behavior and browser requests for a business-depth link.
hypotheses.result: Supported by prior guard and candidate source test; public browser verification pending.

fix.change: Withdraw exhausted-media deal cards, render public details from accepted snapshots, warm new-tab detail documents, preconnect media origins and prioritize primary detail images.
fix.evidence: Focused source contracts passed; build and production proof remain pending.

remaining_unknowns: Whether every supplier image host reuses the preconnect under iOS Safari
authorization_boundary: The current request authorizes implementation and public deployment after release gates pass.
